description: Style/content transfer with edge control signals using the Cosmos Transfer 2B model.
inputInstructions: Provide the transfer prompt via the COSMOS_TRANSFER_PROMPT file metadata key (or PROMPT in the config). COSMOS_TRANSFER_CONTROL_TYPE (edge/depth/segmentation/blur) and COSMOS_TRANSFER_CONTROL_PATH file metadata select the control signal at run time. DISABLE_GUARDRAILS toggles the model guardrails and CONTROL_WEIGHT sets the control-signal strength.
